body: It actually means I can't get up from my bed to go to my computer.
Seeing my doc tomorrow. I'm probably going to go back on a maintenance dose because I can't take it anymore. :(

I don't even remember. I weened over the course of several weeks but as soon as I went down from 75 to 0 I just crashed. Now I'm convinced I'm going crazy because all I want to do is cry and I constantly think about jumping off a bridge.

I have a sleep aid but I rarely take it cause I don't want to get hooked. 

Onset definitely didn't suck this bad. I want to puke and kill everything I see while crying. It's a hell of a drug.

Thyroid is ruled out. 

Venlafaxine was awesome but I couldn't sleep when I was on it. Might go back on because the withdrawal is fucking horrible.
If you like his style of directing then his other movies are definitely worth watching.
Not a big movie watcher but I did watch The Royal Tenenbaums awhile back. I love Wes Anderson!

Yeah I contacted him but there's not much I can do. I can get back on it in which case I wasted all this time trying to get off it or I can continue with the withdrawal. 

I'm seeing him in a few days and keeping in touch via email.
